# Get list of valid app names from specs
valid_apps=$(ls machtzev/generator/specs-ds/*.txt | grep -oE '[a-z0-9]+\.txt$' | sed 's/\.txt$//')

# Find files with valid pattern that don't match valid apps
orphans=$(ls new/dart-data-bs/auto/gen_app_*.dart 2>/dev/null | while read f; do

  if ! echo "$valid_apps" | grep -q "^${name}$"; then
